description: Source code for gtest internal filepath utilities, including path manipulation, directory creation, and file existence checks.

classes.name: FilePath
classes.description: Utility class for handling file and directory paths, including path normalization, existence checks, and path manipulation methods.

methods.name: GetCurrentDir
methods.description: Returns the current working directory as a FilePath object.

methods.name: RemoveExtension
methods.description: Removes a case-insensitive extension from the filename.

methods.name: FindLastPathSeparator
methods.description: Finds the last occurrence of a path separator in the path.

methods.name: RemoveDirectoryName
methods.description: Removes the directory part, leaving only the filename.

methods.name: RemoveFileName
methods.description: Removes the filename, leaving only the directory path.

methods.name: MakeFileName
methods.description: Constructs a filename with optional numbering and extension.

methods.name: ConcatPaths
methods.description: Concatenates directory and relative path into a full path.

methods.name: FileOrDirectoryExists
methods.description: Checks if the path exists in the filesystem.

methods.name: IsRootDirectory
methods.description: Checks if the path is a root directory.

methods.name: IsAbsolutePath
methods.description: Checks if the path is absolute.

methods.name: GenerateUniqueFileName
methods.description: Generates a unique filename that does not exist yet.

methods.name: IsDirectory
methods.description: Checks if the path is a directory.

methods.name: CreateDirectoriesRecursively
methods.description: Creates directory and parent directories as needed.

methods.name: RemoveTrailingPathSeparator
methods.description: Removes trailing separator if path is a directory.

methods.name: Normalize
methods.description: Removes redundant separators from the path.
